name: lvalue-test-e2785cbb54/lvalue-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; "ballerina/lang.error" lists only "message".
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" includes "error:message" but not error:detail.
reason: The case asserts exact runtime error detail messages through err.detail()["message"] for failed list expansion and record field updates. error:detail is absent from both the supported lang.error methods and the permitted langlib method-call list, so this essential asserted behavior makes the whole case a feature request.
test_design_notes: io:println is output instrumentation. Supported assignment/lvalue syntax and integer/string subtypes do not remove the unsupported error-detail dependency.
